public_rationale: The records establish departures by multiple prominent figures: Mira Murati, Bob McGrew, Barret Zoph, Ilya Sutskever and John Schulman. Their documented leadership and founding roles support the ordinary reading that many leading people had left. This does not establish that most top talent departed or that the remaining team was weak.
limitations: “Best” is interpreted as documented prominence, not a measured ranking of ability.
The examples are illustrative rather than a complete personnel census.
Greg Brockman's sabbatical is not counted.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Many of OpenAI's best people have left the company.

statement.excerpt: Many of their best people have left.
statement.document_title: GPT-5: Overdue, overhyped and underwhelming. And that’s not the worst of it.

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that numerous prominent OpenAI personnel had departed by the post date.
“Best people” means people with documented founding, senior research or major technical leadership roles. It is not an objective ranking of individual ability.
“Many” does not mean most employees or most leaders.
“Have left” is cumulative. No starting date is supplied, so the target period has no asserted lower bound and ends on August 9, 2025.
Sabbaticals and merely announced future departures are not counted as permanent departures unless later records establish that the person left before the post.
criteria.support_condition: Public records establish several distinct departures by prominent founders or technical leaders before the post.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable employment records show that the purported numerous departures did not occur, or principally concern people without the claimed prominence.

evidence.explanation: The note acknowledges the departures of Bob McGrew and Barret Zoph, discusses Mira Murati's departure, and describes a senior leadership succession. Subsequent reporting in e6 corroborates that Murati and Zoph had left.

Reuters documents the departure of a co-founder and chief scientist, a clear instance of senior technical prominence. This item uses reporting because the attempted company departure page could not be read.

evidence.locator: Paragraph identifying Thinking Machines Lab's chief scientist
evidence.explanation: The report identifies John Schulman as an OpenAI co-founder and confirms his completed departure. It also identifies Murati as the former CTO and Zoph as a prominent researcher who left alongside her.

Zoph directly announces his exit and describes building and running OpenAI's post-training team and helping scale ChatGPT. This establishes technical prominence rather than relying solely on a job title.
